about_the_game:
Love Penguin Panic? Love penguins? Love music? Then you'll love this soundtrack. It contains the most catchy tunes of the game, composed by its designer: Jeroen Derwort.

When you own the game, through this music you will relive its most heroic and frantic moments. Close your eyes and imagine you're a penguin. It doesn't get any better than that!

Fun fact: some of the music was made using an 8-bit MSX computer. For this, a real Moonsound OPL4 soundcard was used. There's also some Konami SCC cartridge-music added to the mix.

Extra: a bonus track from never released turn-based strategy game The Last Battle For Peace is included.

This music is bundled as free additional content for Penguin Panic.

name: Penguin Panic! Soundtrack
short_description: The music of Penguin Panic combines playful, retro-inspired chiptune melodies with a sense of icy tension and adventure. Bright arpeggios and bouncy rhythms capture the charm of the game's pixel art world, while subtle minor tones add urgency as players race to find their precious eggs.
